title: Two moves, in the right order

ask.text: Close it.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Lift the lip before you share the deck. Outward-in, top first.
With the lip gone, 5 deck segments are carrying 20.

worldFraming.text: The span is bolted and then ballasted. Unballast before you unbolt.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 3 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: Outward-in, top first. The bridge tells you instantly if you reach for the bolts.
